text:
The dish looks like scrambled eggs topped with green salsa (salsa verde) and diced tomato, served on a white plate. The plate is probably about 24-26 cm across. The eggs cover roughly 10-12 cm, and the pile is fairly thick.

Weight: about 150 g of eggs, plus about 30 g of salsa and tomato, gives roughly 180 g in total.

Energy: scrambled eggs with butter or oil run about 1.6 kcal/g, so 150 g is about 240 kcal. The salsa and tomato add about 25 kcal. That totals about 265 kcal, which I'll round to 260.

{"kcal": 260, "mass_g": 180}
